statements.statement: Jimmy Essex (born 18 November 1984) is an English actor.
He is best known for portraying Adam Donovan in the Channel 4 soap opera ''Hollyoaks'' from 2016 to 2018.
Essex has also appeared in ''The Sandman'' (2022) and ''EastEnders'' (2025).
Essex was born in England and trained at The Urdang Academy.
He began his career as a dancer before transitioning into acting roles.
Essex made his acting debut in a series of music videos in 2014, including ''Mr Bowler Presents - Hideaway'', ''Pitiful'', and ''Sacrifice'', where he appeared as a male dancer.
In 2016, he joined the cast of the Channel 4 soap opera ''Hollyoaks'' as Adam Donovan, a police detective and part of the Donovan family storyline.
His character was involved in dramatic plots, including family conflicts, relationships, and criminal investigations.
Essex appeared in 159 episodes until his character's death in 2018.
He has spoken positively about his time on the show, noting his enjoyment working with co-stars and his appreciation for the role's development.
Following ''Hollyoaks'', Essex appeared in the horror film ''A Dark Path'' (2020) as Peter.
In 2022, he had a recurring role as Carrion in the Netflix series ''The Sandman'', appearing in two episodes.
He also starred in the short film ''Daddy Issues'' (2024) as Felix.
In November 2025, Essex guest-starred in the BBC soap opera ''EastEnders'' as Rich, a minor character who appeared in one episode as a disruptive patron at a bar, harassing other characters.
Essex maintains an active presence on social media, where he shares updates about his acting and writing projects.
He has expressed interest in writing and has described himself as an actor and writer.
Essex has a sister named Olivia.
He has been in a long-term relationship with musician Charles Gay since at least 2013.
In August 2025, he publicly celebrated 13 years together.
In November 2025, he marked six years with his partner Alvaro Campos.
